name: Storm
bio: Weather-controlling mutant, former street thief in Cairo, worshipped as a goddess in Kenya, queen of Wakanda by marriage, and the X-Men's most frequent leader after Cyclops. A stabilising presence whose friendships are usually mentorships.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Claremont Era
era.description: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975) through Chris Claremont's departure after X-Men #3 (1991). The all-new team, Phoenix, Days of Future Past, the Brood, Inferno.

relationships.label: Closest confidants, briefly lovers
relationships.summary: The two most senior members of the 1975 team, each the other's most trusted colleague. Written as a near-sibling friendship for decades, with a romantic period during Jason Aaron's Wolverine and the X-Men (2012–2014) that the line has mostly treated as a chapter rather than a change.

events.note: Storm takes over as team leader with Logan's backing.
Storm and Logan begin a relationship.
Logan dies; Storm leads the mourning.

relationships.label: Big sister, then peer
relationships.summary: Storm was the first adult X-Man Kitty bonded with; the relationship strained when Storm's punk-era change (Uncanny X-Men #173) frightened her, and matured into equals by the time Kitty led the team.

events.note: Storm recruits Kitty in Deerfield, Illinois.
Kitty rejects Storm's new look and the two fall out.

relationships.summary: Close from the start of the new team; Storm was Jean's closest female friend through the Phoenix years and held the team together in her absences.

events.note: Jean becomes Phoenix; Storm is at her side.
Returned Jean recruits Storm first for her new team.
